description.value: Empire Garden is a full-service Szechwan and Cantonese restaurant in Langley's Walnut Grove neighbourhood, drawing diners from across the Lower Mainland for dishes like dim sum, live fresh seafood, and made-to-order entrees. The banquet facility seats up to 160 people and the kitchen offers pickup and delivery, giving passing cyclists flexibility on how they order. Vegetarian options are part of the regular menu.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (7 spaces) at 44m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the OSM phone (604 882-1111) and address (#100 - 20378 - 88th Avenue, Langley). Takeout is confirmed by 'Walnut Grove Reservations / Take Out' and a dedicated pickup/delivery menu page. Vegetarian dishes are explicitly listed among the menu offerings. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities. Two concerns flag: menus are labeled '2013' suggesting the website content is very stale, and a subpage (/new-zealand-casinos/) promoting online gambling is unrelated to the business, indicating the site may have been compromised.
